name: Book 2 Foundation And Outline
core_requirements: Publish one evidence-backed Book 2 audit disposition from the three allowed outcomes.

Create a canonical prose and machine Book 2 outline covering purpose, entry, exit, chapter spine, all 12 paragraph roles, dependencies, retrieval/interleaving, operation balance, conventions, misconceptions, readiness, and holds.
Preserve exact blueprint and target source hashes, all 12 IDs/order/kinds/statuses, and per-record hashes.
Prevent preview or familiarity from being promoted to prerequisite mastery.
Make the prose outline the sole semantic authority and keep machine metadata compact, identity- and freshness-oriented.
Use action-scoped releasable holds whose released state requires evidence and no longer blocks its named action.
Insert a complete Book foundation check into all required paragraph/chapter planning and review surfaces, owned by a Part A X.Y.Z-textbook-plan.md created from its dedicated template.
Add a reusable currentness checker, approved-use mode, mutation tests, npm commands, CI wiring, and GitHub navigation pointer.
Keep blueprints, target registry, protected references, and the lesson repository unchanged.
Complete teacher, economics, curriculum-sequencing, and structural review, then stop before human owner approval and merge.
scope: Audit current Book 2 blueprint, target, boundary, exercise-contract, and lesson planning evidence.
Create a canonical derived Book 2 outline and machine companion for all 12 paragraphs.
Insert a mandatory Book foundation check into paragraph and chapter planning workflows.
Add a reusable currentness checker, approved-outline mode, mutation tests, and CI enforcement.
Prepare role-based and structural review evidence, then stop before owner approval and integration.
forbidden: No lesson repository edits or generated output.
No blueprint, target-registry, protected machine, or external reference mutation.
No approval of Issue #223 paragraph goals or target.
No merge, auto-merge, or integration authorization.
